releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.78 improves WhatsApp Inbox with local visual thumbnails: images show their real picture, videos show a generated frame with a play badge, and PDFs show a first-page preview while other documents keep type icons. Price Photos now supports multiple barcodes for one saved product, photo and price. A new flavor or variant barcode can be added to an existing product without taking another picture, and scanning any linked barcode opens the same saved product. Existing single-barcode products migrate automatically, barcode search covers all linked codes, individual barcodes can be managed/removed, and the original product photo/price/category remain unchanged.
